solutions.title: Set backtracking
solutions.strategy: Place queens row by row while tracking occupied columns and diagonals in sets.

timeComplexity.explanation: Backtracking tries permutations of columns pruned by diagonal conflicts.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The board plus tracking sets are stored.

solutions.title: Bitmask backtracking
solutions.strategy: Track available columns and diagonals with bit masks while building board rows.

timeComplexity.explanation: The same search tree is explored with lower constant-factor checks.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Result boards dominate output storage; recursion uses O(n).
